name: Menzie's giant rattlesnake-plantain
desc: Menzie's giant rattlesnake-plantain (Goodyera oblongifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Goodyera oblongifolia is a species of orchid known by the common names western rattlesnake plantain and giant rattlesnake plantain.
